title: Explore Pikes Peak and Garden of the Gods Full Day Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Journey into the heart of Colorado with a full-day tour to Pikes Peak and the Garden of the Gods. Experience the stunning views along the scenic drive up Pikes Peak, where you can breathe in the crisp alpine air and take in expansive vistas. After exploring the historic town of Manitou Springs, enjoy a leisurely lunch, then marvel at the breathtaking sandstone formations at the Garden of the Gods. Perfect for nature enthusiasts and photographers alike, this tour offers a local expert guide to navigate the route for you, ensuring an enriching adventure. 
*Fall through spring, access to Pikes Peak summit may be limited due to weather.

- Full-day tour lasting 8.5 hours, departing from Denver
- Scenic drive with photo opportunities at Pikes Peak and Garden of the Gods
- Explore charming Manitou Springs with time for lunch on your own
- Limited to 13 travelers for an intimate experience with a local guide
